name: Tkashi Ruins
summary: Bloodscalp trolls guard the Tkashi Ruins southwest of Nesingwary's Expedition in northern Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Stones of the Bloodscalp
sections.body: Southwest of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting camp, crumbling stones mark an ancient domain of Stranglethorn's jungle trolls. The Bloodscalp tribe now occupies the ruins and fiercely defends its territory. Among the vines and decayed stone, they practice shamanistic rituals. Hemet Nesingwary wrote that he passed through without trouble, but travelers now face Bloodscalp guards protecting tribal relics buried in the rubble.

faq.q: Who lives in the Tkashi Ruins?
faq.answer: The Bloodscalp tribe lives in the ruins. These hostile jungle trolls defend the crumbling compound against outsiders and rival tribes.

faq.q: Where are the Tkashi Ruins located?
faq.answer: The Tkashi Ruins lie in northern Stranglethorn Vale, just southwest of the river crossing near Nesingwary's Expedition.

faq.q: What is mentioned about Tkashi in Hemet Nesingwary's writings?
faq.answer: In chapter three of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, Hemet Nesingwary writes that he and his hunting party crossed the Tkashi Ruins without incident during their early days in the jungle. He records it on page twenty-one.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you may see Tkashi as a grim reminder of ancient tribal ruins left by your hostile Gurubashi kin. Savage Bloodscalp holdouts now defend the site.
